info.description: Copy with a run of single words beside it, each carrying a small symbol, and one or two photographs. ⚠ The numbering, the run direction, the reveal delays and the frame geometry are design and stay in the page.

headingSecond.description: The start of the second line, in the ordinary weight. Leave empty when the whole second line is italic.

headingEm.description: The end of the heading, set in italic. The page puts the line break in.

imageTwo.description: Optional — some sections carry one photograph, some two.
